description: Manage the plan status, its base limits and the assignments that use this catalog.

guidance.activate: The plan becomes available for new assignments.
guidance.deprecate: The plan stops being the recommended option for new assignments.
guidance.archive: The plan is retired. This transition is irreversible.
guidance.archived: The plan is already archived and has no further lifecycle transitions.
guidance.none: No transitions are available for the current plan status.

deleteHelp: Delete only plans that were never assigned. If an active or past assignment exists, the API rejects the action and the reason appears in the confirmation.
deleteHelpActive: Active plans are retired with “Mark as deprecated” before they are archived or deleted.
assignedSummary: {count, plural, =0 {No active organizations are assigned to this plan.} one {1 active organization uses this plan.} other {# active organizations use this plan.}}
assignedUnknown: Active assignments: not available in this detail.

info.title: Plan summary
info.noDescription: This plan has no description recorded.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.help: Features enabled or blocked for organizations assigned to this plan.
capabilities.emptyTitle: This plan has no capabilities configured
capabilities.emptyDescription: Assigned organizations get no extra features from this plan.

limits.title: Base limits
limits.helpEditable: Use -1 for unlimited. Changes stay as a local draft until you save the row.
limits.helpReadOnly: Limits are read-only because the plan is {status, select, draft {draft} active {active} deprecated {deprecated} archived {archived} other {archived}}.
limits.calloutDraft: These changes prepare the catalog before it is assigned to organizations. Type a whole number and use Save to confirm each row.
limits.calloutActiveEmptyTitle: Editing an active plan with no assignments
limits.calloutActive: {affected} Type a whole number and use Save to confirm each row; Reset asks for confirmation because it changes effective entitlements.
limits.calloutReadOnly: The plan is {status, select, draft {draft} active {active} deprecated {deprecated} archived {archived} other {archived}}; its limits can no longer be edited from this view.
limits.affected: {count, plural, =0 {No active organizations are currently affected.} one {Affects 1 active organization assigned to this plan.} other {Affects # active organizations assigned to this plan.}}
limits.affectedUnknown: The number of affected organizations is not available in this detail.
limits.caption: Plan limits
limits.inputHelp: Use -1 for unlimited. Press Enter or Save to confirm the change and Escape to discard it.
limits.required: Enter -1, 0 or a positive whole number.
limits.invalid: Use -1 for unlimited, 0 or a positive whole number.
limits.resetName: Reset limit for {dimension} to its default value
limits.emptyTitle: This plan has no quota dimensions configured
limits.emptyDescription: When the catalog defines quota dimensions, you can adjust their limits here.
limits.saved: {key} was accepted by the API and the row was reconciled with the saved profile.
limits.resetDone: {key} now reflects the default value returned by the API.
limits.resetFailedTitle: The limit could not be reset

assignments.title: Assigned organizations
assignments.help: To change assignments, open an organization and manage its plan from that organization's detail.

dialog.typeInstruction: Type the exact plan name ({name}) to confirm.
dialog.deprecateDescription: You are about to mark {name} as deprecated. {impact}
dialog.deleteDescription: You are about to delete {name}. Deletion is only allowed for plans that were never assigned. If the plan has history, archive it to retire it and keep the audit trail.
dialog.resetDescription: You are about to reset {dimension} to its default value. {impact} The row is reconciled with the persisted value the API returns.
dialog.resetImpactActive: {affected} Organizations will see the effective value the plan returns after you confirm.
dialog.resetImpactInactive: The plan is not active; Reset still removes the explicit value of this dimension.

feedback.lifecycleTitle: The status could not be updated
feedback.deleteTitle: The plan could not be deleted
feedback.limitTitle: The limit action could not be completed
feedback.errorMessage: The service could not complete the request. Retry the request.
feedback.networkMessage: The service did not respond. Retry the request.
feedback.outcomeUnknown: No response was received and we do not know whether the status change was applied. Retry sends the same request again; if the plan already changed, the service reports that the transition is not allowed.
feedback.codeMessage: Code {code}: the request could not be completed.
feedback.noAccessTitle: You do not have permission to change this plan
feedback.noAccessDescription: The service rejected the action. The data shown has not changed and the change actions are disabled until you reload the page.
feedback.notFoundTitle: The plan or limit no longer exists
feedback.notFoundDescription: The service did not find the resource. Go back to the catalog to check its state.
feedback.sessionDescription: Your session was renewed. The action was not sent again: repeat it to continue.

code.INVALID_LIMIT_VALUE: INVALID_LIMIT_VALUE: use -1 for unlimited, 0 or a positive whole number.
code.PLAN_LIMITS_FROZEN: PLAN_LIMITS_FROZEN: this plan no longer accepts limit changes.
code.PLAN_HAS_ASSIGNMENT_HISTORY: PLAN_HAS_ASSIGNMENT_HISTORY: the API rejected the deletion because this plan has active or past assignments. Archive it to retire it without breaking the history.
code.PLAN_HAS_ACTIVE_ASSIGNMENTS: PLAN_HAS_ACTIVE_ASSIGNMENTS: the plan has active organizations assigned. Change those assignments before continuing.
code.PLAN_ACTIVE: PLAN_ACTIVE: first mark the plan as deprecated and archive it; active plans are not deleted directly.
code.INVALID_TRANSITION: INVALID_TRANSITION: this transition is not allowed for the current plan status.

success.lifecycle: {name} is now {status, select, draft {draft} active {active} deprecated {deprecated} archived {archived} other {archived}}.

load.errorTitle: The plan could not be loaded
load.errorMessage: The plan or its limits could not be fetched. Retry the request.
load.networkMessage: The service did not respond. Retry the request.
load.noAccessTitle: You do not have permission to view this plan
load.noAccessDescription: Contact a platform administrator to view the plan.
load.notFoundDescription: No plan exists with this identifier. Go back to the catalog to pick another.
